user.title: Health Assistant
user.description: Set up Health Assistant. All health data stays local to this Home Assistant instance.

abort.already_configured: Health Assistant is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

init.title: Entity mappings
init.description: Map existing sensors to canonical health metrics. Mapped sensors are ingested into the local health store as their state changes.

add_observation.name: Add observation
add_observation.description: Writes a single health observation into the local health store.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the supplied value. Defaults to the metric's canonical unit.

observed_at.name: Observed at
observed_at.description: When the measurement was taken. Defaults to now.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Person identifier. Defaults to the primary person.

external_id.name: External ID
external_id.description: Stable source identifier. Supplying one makes repeated calls idempotent.

source.name: Source
source.description: Free-form source label stored as provenance.

add_body_measurement.name: Add body measurement
add_body_measurement.description: Writes weight, body fat, and lean mass readings that share one timestamp.

weight_unit.name: Weight unit
weight_unit.description: Unit of the weight value. Defaults to kilograms.

lean_mass_unit.name: Lean mass unit
lean_mass_unit.description: Unit of the lean mass value. Defaults to kilograms.

observed_at.name: Observed at
observed_at.description: When the measurements were taken. Defaults to now.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Person identifier. Defaults to the primary person.

external_id.name: External ID
external_id.description: Stable source identifier shared by the readings.

source.name: Source
source.description: Free-form source label stored as provenance.

add_workout.name: Add workout
add_workout.description: Writes a workout into the local health store.

workout_type.name: Workout type
workout_type.description: Kind of workout, such as strength or running.

distance_unit.name: Distance unit
distance_unit.description: Unit of the distance value. Defaults to meters.
